name: CaseMediaNonMatching
description: SEED contract for the CSS/DOM conformance fixture case "media-non-matching" (at-rules). The fixture varies CSS CONSTRUCTS, not prop spaces, so the prop space is deliberately EMPTY: every axis the capture would enumerate is held at nothing, and the whole measurement is the computed truth of one mounted rendering. Construct: @media (min-width: 2000px) branch that does NOT match the pinned viewport
